cohort: Hospitalized obstetrical cases from 19 tertiary and 20 secondary hospitals in 14 provinces in mainland China during 2011
finding: The incidence of several obstetrical diseases remains high in mainland China, with a cesarean section rate exceeding World Health Organization recommendations, largely attributed to maternal request.
mod_finding: The cesarean section (CS) rate was 54.77%, much higher than World Health Organization recommendations, in which cesarean delivery by maternal request (CDMR) accounted for a large proportion.
